strings.name: Robin Zeng
strings.summary: Robin Zeng co-founded consumer-battery producer ATL before establishing CATL for electric-vehicle and energy-storage batteries. His influence combines research, supply-chain organization and manufacturing scale. His career illustrates Chinese battery companies' expansion into global automotive supply chains; technical achievements belong to the research and production teams involved.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026; events reach 10 November 2026. Appointments follow the listing prospectus and recent activity records. Corporate technologies are not presented as individual inventions; live wealth and market-share figures are excluded.

strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Two battery ventures
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Co-founded ATL in 1999 and established CATL in 2011, moving from consumer batteries into vehicles and energy storage.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Battery supply at scale
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Led CATL's vehicle and storage battery expansion, broadening financing through mainland and overseas listings.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Benchmark Lifetime Achievement Award
strings.timeline.event-01.text: CATL and the award organizer announced recognition of his contribution to battery industrialization.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: CATL lists in Hong Kong
strings.timeline.event-02.text: Following its Shenzhen listing, CATL entered Hong Kong's market to broaden international financing.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Becomes CATL general manager
strings.timeline.event-03.text: Added general-manager responsibilities to his chairmanship, overseeing overall strategy and development.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: CATL lists in Shenzhen
strings.timeline.event-04.text: The company listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange under code 300750.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Becomes CATL chairman
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Assumed the chairmanship and continued shaping strategic planning and development.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Founds CATL
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Established the company with its founding team, focusing on vehicle and energy-storage batteries.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Co-founds ATL
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Developed lithium-ion batteries for consumer electronics with partners, building manufacturing and research experience.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Graduates from Shanghai Jiao Tong
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Received a bachelor's degree before entering industrial engineering work.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Born in Ningde
strings.timeline.event-09.text: Birthplace and month are corroborated by the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce biography.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded CATL, advancing traction-battery research, large-scale manufacturing and global electric-vehicle supply chains.
